div.font: Figure. EnrichEx enrichment analysis framework. (A) Overlap enrichment tests query gene lists against gene set collections using Fisher's exact test. (B) Burden testing aggregates qualifying variants per gene set and tests case-control association via Hail-native regression, with optional stratified analysis by variant class and competitive permutation testing.
